notes.title: New Horror Game Coming & Update on Venomyth Games!
notes.content:
Hey guys! I know it has been 2 years now or almost 3 I believe when I first made Humble Abode and I haven't been active since because of issues I had going on but the great news is I am back and I have a new game I am waiting for to be released here called Fatal Curse! 

This game is not a sequel to Humble Abode, it's a standalone. I would love to work on the sequel to HA but there were some issues with the people I have been working with. I will try to work on HA2 but please keep in mind, I develop these games alone so it will take some time while weighing on other things I have doing in life. I have seen some comments, reviews and help forums on this game and I am happy that there was many that enjoyed the game and took the time to create forums on my game. I appreciate it dearly. 

Lastly, there will be no more added content, achievements or patches on this game as I am now focused on doing so for Fatal Curse when the time comes and future games. If there are any questions you have on this game or on Fatal Curse or anything of the sort, feel free to leave a comment or you can always reach out to Venomyth Games facebook page. Thank you and stay safe everyone! 

https://www.facebook.com/Venomythgames

notes.title: A new horror game coming soon!
notes.content:
I know that is has been some time since Humble Abode was released but I am proud to announce a new horror game called Fatal Curse coming soon on April 9th! You guys can also check Venomyth Facebook page for more details!

notes.title: A new update for Humble Abode!
notes.content:
A new update for Humble Abode has arrived!

- Fixed a glitch inside the guest room with the TV.

- Added a prompt at the beginning of the game to notify players how to sprint.

- New bonus story is available to play from the main menu.

We are still working on adding achievements for this game while working on the next installment of this series, which should be available this summer! Stay tuned.
